name: edit_captions
description:
Manage captions/subtitles through an SRT-like, time-ordered Card model. To inspect caption text content, use the `read_captions` tool; legacy projects may persist a one-time derived-caption reconciliation before returning the read.

# When to read first
- Card-targeted actions (`set_card_text`, `set_card_tokens`, `set_card_style`, `set_card_span_style`, `set_card_layout`, `split_card`, `merge_cards`, `reset_card`) require one `read_captions` call for Card ids and the current revision. Submit the whole requested edit in one call.
- To inspect built-in presets for the current caption languages, call `template` with no preset; it resolves the language-aware catalog without a separate `read_captions` call.
- Track-wide style, template, layout, source, translation, and lifecycle actions are direct calls. Do not read first unless the request depends on current content.

# Actions

## Lifecycle
- `enable` / `disable` — non-destructively toggle captions while preserving Card edits, translations, source configuration, and styles. This pair is not a rebuild and must not be used to clear an error or reset authored data; use confirmed `reset` for that. First-pass/default source behavior resolves every audible timeline track into explicit `sourceScope.sources`, not a single V1/A1 track. For captions with no aesthetic request, omit `preset`; omitted `preset` and `preset:"auto"` both mean the default Plain visual style with Auto segmentation. For a generic aesthetic request, enable first and then use the language-aware `template` catalog. `enable` also accepts a built-in preset name via the `preset` field when the user explicitly asks for that specific look. Do NOT pass `trackId` / `trackOrder` to `enable`; to narrow to a specific source after enabling, use `set_sources`.
- `refresh` — explicitly rebuild the Caption Program and bypasses the 30-minute automatic cutoff. Use this before Card-level edits when `read_captions` reports stale captions.
- `reset` — destructive clean rebuild for a caption set that cannot reconcile, including legacy translated captions with word-level edits. Require explicit user approval and pass `{"confirm":true}`. It preserves the caption block's visual style, layout, and original-language source selection, then discards all existing caption text, translations, Card edits, and word overrides before generating a fresh Program. Do not use it for a normal style or wording request.

## Display override
- `set_card_text` — replace one Card's viewer text without changing its id or timing. Pass `{"cardId":"<cardId>","text":"replacement","revision":"..."}` using values from `read_captions`; add `languageCode` to target a translation variant in bilingual Cards. Unknown fields are rejected without mutating the Card.
- `set_card_tokens` — atomically replace or retime individual authored Card tokens. First call `read_captions {"words":true}`, then pass `{"cardId":"<cardId>","revision":"...","tokens":[{"tokenId":"<token-id>","text":"replacement"},{"tokenId":"<token-id>","fromFrame":120,"endFrame":132}]}`. Frame values are absolute timeline frames. Timing must remain positive, ordered, non-overlapping, and inside the Card. Text-only replacement preserves timing; timing edits are marked manual.
- `set_card_style` — patch one Card with canonical `captionStyle:{"version":1,"token":{"color":"#8B4513"}}`, plus parallel `fontFamily`, `fontFallbacks`, `presentation`, and `pagination`. captionStyle accepts CSS slots only and rejects layout/geometry; use `set_card_layout` for those. Flat `style` is a deprecated compatibility input. Omit `sourceId` only to style every visible source in that Card.
- Exact-word resizing is supported. When the user wants highlighted or named words larger or smaller, use `set_card_span_style` with `style.fontSizeScale` (for example, `1.15` for 15% larger). Do not use Card-level `sizePx` / `fontSizeRatio`, do not resize the whole Card, and never claim span font sizing is unsupported.
- `set_card_span_style` — style exact text spans inside one Card without changing its text, timing, boundaries, or whole-Card style. Pass all requested spans together as `{"cardId":"<cardId>","spans":[{"text":"South America","style":{"fontFamily":"Bangers","fontWeight":"700","fontSizeScale":1.2},"activeStyle":{"color":"#1A1A1A","backgroundColor":"#FACC15","animation":{"enter":{"durationMs":180,"keyframes":[{"offset":0,"opacity":0},{"offset":1,"opacity":1}]}}}}],"revision":"..."}`. IMPORTANT: `style` and `activeStyle` are sibling fields in each span object. `style` controls the always-visible appearance; `activeStyle` controls the timed-active appearance and is the only span field that accepts canonical animation. Never put `activeStyle` inside `style`. Animation samples the active overlay over stable normal text: if a yellow background itself should fade or move, put `backgroundColor` in `activeStyle`, not `style`. A background in `style` remains visible before, during, and after activation; animation with no active paint difference can be visually inert. `fontFamily` changes only the selected span and is loaded for both preview and export. `fontSizeScale` is relative to the effective Card font size, so 1.2 makes only the selected text 20% larger and continues to follow later whole-caption size changes. The tool resolves and returns the exact line, offsets, token ids, and source-token ids that were changed. If the same text occurs more than once in the eligible Card content, pass 1-based `occurrence`; add `languageCode` to target one bilingual projection. Pass `style:null` to clear the exact span's local style. Overlapping spans compose in stored order, so a smaller span can override only selected style fields inside a larger span.
- `set_card_layout` — move or resize exactly one Card/page, including vertically with `top`. Pass `{"cardId":"<cardId>","layout":{"left":220,"top":760,"width":700},"revision":"..."}`. When the user references one language/presentation in a bilingual Card, also pass its exact `sourceId` to move only that source in this Card: `{"cardId":"<cardId>","sourceId":"<english-source-id>","layout":{"top":760},"revision":"..."}`. Omit `sourceId` to move every visible line in the Card together. Other Cards remain unchanged. Fields are optional but at least one is required. A width-only edit keeps the Card's current horizontal center fixed and puts both wrap dimensions for that Card into Auto: local Max Characters per line is derived from width and local Max Lines expands or contracts to the visual rows needed by the existing Card. It rewraps that Card without splitting, merging, retiming, restyling, or changing another Card. When `left` is also supplied, the explicit position wins. Use `source_layout` instead to move one language across all Cards. Pass `layout:null` to restore the matching Card/source geometry and inherited Source/global constraints while preserving text, translation, and style edits. Use `layout` instead when the request applies to every Card for one Source.
- `set_max_characters` — set the Caption Program's maximum characters in one visual row. Pass `{"scope":"all","value":12,"revision":"..."}`; this clears per-Card width/character constraints and resegments Cards without changing their source text or timing. It does not accept a Card id or convert characters into pixels. To change one Card's visual wrapping, use `set_card_layout.width`. After either edit, read again and verify the actual `layoutLines` and `overflow` state.
- `split_card` — split one Card before interior timed words. First call `read_captions {"words":true}`, then pass `{"cardId":"<cardId>","beforeWordKey":"<token-id>","revision":"..."}`; each selected word starts a new Card. For THREE or more Cards in one operation, pass every boundary in ONE call: `{"cardId":"<cardId>","beforeWordKeys":["<token-a>","<token-b>"],"revision":"..."}`. The result returns each piece's new `cardId` and `editId`; use those ids directly for follow-up edits. Pieces can be split again, edited, styled, laid out, and merged with any adjacent Card subset. Resetting any related piece clears the whole connected structural edit and restores the automatic source Cards. Timing, source links, variants, and per-Card presentation are preserved; the operation fails rather than creating an empty retained language variant.
- `merge_cards` — merge adjacent Cards into one authored Card. Pass `{"cardIds":["<cardId>","<cardId>"],"revision":"..."}`. Text and timing are preserved in order.
- `reset_card` — remove one Card's custom edit and reveal its automatic source-backed text again. Pass the Card's `editId` from `read_captions` as `{"cardId":"<editId>","revision":"..."}`. For structural edits, reset atomically removes the connected split/merge component and restores its automatic source Cards.
- `resegment_cards` — LEGACY alias kept for pre-Card clients; prefer `style` with `pacing` for new calls. Exact shape: `{"mode":"natural"|"short-phrase"|"word-by-word","revision":"..."}` — `mode` is required (a bare string or `{"segmentation":...}` is rejected) and `revision` comes from `read_captions`. It maps natural→auto, short-phrase→phrase, and word-by-word→word structural pagination. The operation invalidates previous Card ids.
- `cue_override` / `cue_reset` — legacy compatibility aliases for pre-Card clients. Both require the current `revision` from `read_captions`. New agents must use the Card actions above.

## Style
A caption track's look can be changed with a built-in preset (`template`) or explicit custom fields (`style`). Use `set_card_style` when the user identifies one Card. Prefer built-in presets because they provide more stable results.
When asking the user to choose a caption style in ChatCut's native chat, use the `widget-forms` skill to show previews in a `<widget>` for selection.
- `template` — list or apply built-in caption presets. Call it with no preset to read the language-aware catalog. For a specific language source in bilingual captions, pass JSON `{"languageCode":"en"}`. An untargeted call considers every visible language; when their catalogs differ, the tool requires a languageCode instead of choosing one source's catalog. Listing returns compact selection metadata: id, English `name`, Chinese-catalog `localizedName`, `styleProfile`, and `paginationProfile`. Apply a returned preset with `templatePreset` (preferred; `preset` is deprecated); it preserves size, position, Max Lines, and Max Characters. A valid built-in may also be applied directly by name.
- `style` — set the canonical contract: `{"captionStyle":{"version":1,"container":{"fontSize":"72px"},"token":{"color":"#ffffff"}},"fontFamily":"Inter","presentation":{"highlightUnit":"word"},"pagination":{"wordsPerPage":null}}`. captionStyle accepts CSS slots only and rejects geometry/layout. Flat fields remain deprecated compatibility inputs and normalize immediately into this contract. Use `layout` for width/left/top/position.
- Animation is canonical CSS only: put it in `captionStyle.activeToken.animation` (or a span's sibling `activeStyle.animation`), never legacy top-level fields and never inside a span's `style`. An animation has deterministic `enter` and/or `exit` phases with 0-to-1 increasing keyframe offsets, durationMs, optional `linear`/`ease`/`ease-in`/`ease-out`/`ease-in-out` or `cubic-bezier(...)` easing, and keyframes using opacity, typed transform fields (`translateX`/`translateY` in px or em, `scale`, `rotate`), and bounded `clipPath:"inset(...)"`. Inset accepts 1-4 values from 0-100% or 0-10000px/em; use `inset(0 100% 0 0) → inset(0)` for a left-to-right reveal. Arbitrary `polygon()`, `path()`, `round`, and other CSS keyframe properties are unsupported.
- A request such as "swipe", "swipe up", or "higher swipe" describes keyframe motion; it is NOT a literal animation name. For one word/span, call `set_card_span_style` and encode it in `activeStyle.animation`: use `clipPath inset(0 100% 0 0) → inset(0)` when the highlight itself should wipe left-to-right, or typed `translateY:"0.35em" → "0em"` when the whole active word should move upward. Never retry with `highlightAnimation:"swipe"`, never move a span request to track-wide `style`/`source_update`, and never claim per-span animation is unsupported.
- Whichever route is used, every attribute the user explicitly stated (a color, a band, a highlight, a case) must end up applied; layer `style` on top of `template` when explicit requested details are not part of the preset.
- `preset_save` / `preset_apply` / `preset_rename` / `preset_delete` / `preset_list` — manage USER-saved style presets (separate from built-in `template`).

## Layout
- `layout` — position one caption Source globally across its Cards. Exact pixels (`left` / `top` / `right` / `bottom`) or preset (`bottom` / `top` / `center`, or 3×3 title-safe: `top-left` / `top-center` / `top-right` / `middle-left` / `middle-center` / `middle-right` / `bottom-left` / `bottom-center` / `bottom-right`). Pass `sourceId` when more than one Source is active. `width` / `height` remain shared measurement dimensions; position is never written to Program. To position several Sources atomically use `positions`.
- `source_layout` — move or resize ONE caption source/language without changing its text, translation, style, preset, visibility, or other sources. First call `source_list`, then pass its exact stable `sourceId`: `{"sourceId":"<english-source-id>","anchor":"top-center","offsetYRatio":0.08,"widthRatio":0.8}`. It creates an independent source-specific slot and accepts `anchor`, `widthRatio`, `heightRatio`, `offsetXRatio`, and `offsetYRatio`. Pass `slotId:null` to return that source to automatic placement; arbitrary/shared slot IDs are intentionally rejected. Use `positions` when moving several sources atomically.

## Source
- `track` — legacy/debug only: change the captions item's storage/legacy source `trackId`. Captions render as one timeline-level overlay; `trackId` only anchors the captions item to a timeline and remains the legacy single-source fallback when no `sourceScope` is set. Do NOT use `track` to choose the visible caption text source; use `set_sources` instead.

## Multi-source (one captions item, several speakers/languages on screen)
- `translate` — canonical user-facing caption translation action. For caption programs, it incrementally translates missing/stale cues, stores one bounded `caption_cue_translation_chunk` row per active chunk + language, verifies cue coverage, and then switches the visible language/source without creating page-item rows. Legacy materialized captions retain a compatibility card-owned path. Use this for "translate captions to English", "add bilingual captions", "show Chinese + English subtitles", or "retranslate captions". Pass `{"languageCode":"en"}` for bilingual original+English (default), `{"languageCode":"zh","mode":"bilingual","primary":"translation"}` for the translated line on top, or `{"languageCode":"en","mode":"translation"}` for translation-only. Gemini receives a compact per-Card length target of twice the original Card's visible grapheme count, but a complete translation is retained even when it exceeds that target. Auto-stack renders explicit caption sources top-to-bottom in listed order; `primary` sets that order for the common bilingual pair and an explicit value replaces conflicting manual slots atomically. Add `force:true` or `regenerate:true` only when the user asks to retranslate from scratch; otherwise it translates only missing/stale cues. Optional scope fields `trackId`, `itemId`, or `assetId` narrow cues by stable source anchors; default translates all active cues in the timeline. Max Lines and all-Card Max Characters can resegment Cards, so their result requires a follow-up `read_captions`; if that read reports incomplete translation coverage, immediately run its exact `repairAction` without `force`, then read again and require complete coverage. Do not disable/re-enable captions and do not use `manage_transcript translation_*` for viewer-facing caption translation.
- `bilingual` — legacy convenience for pairing the original source with one existing translation source. For ordinary user requests, prefer `translate`; use `set_sources` for custom arrangements. Languages are ordinary caption sources, not a separate caption mode.
- `source_list` — show every configured source, including hidden sources, plus the layout policy, visible source order, and available tracks. Reuse its exact `sourceId` for later updates/removals.
- `set_sources` — canonical declarative action: replace the whole source scope on the same captions item while preserving presentation for matching logical sources. For normal "caption every audible speaking track on this timeline", pass `{"mode":"timeline"}`. For explicit sources, pass `sources` (array). Each source is `{trackId|assetId|itemId|speakerId, variant?, variantKind?, languageCode?, label?, priority?, slotId?, visible?}`. `variant` selects which transcript to show: `{"variantKind":"translation","languageCode":"en"}` for a translation. Use `translate` first when the translation is not known to exist. Omit variant fields for the original. In auto-stack, sources render top-to-bottom in listed order; in single-lane, order is overlap priority. Pass `{"sourceScope":null}` to clear and use the legacy single-track source.
- `source_set` — legacy compatibility alias for `set_sources`; new calls must use `set_sources`.
- `source_add` — append one source (`{"source":{...}}`) to the existing scope.
- `source_remove` — remove a source by passing the selector at the TOP LEVEL: `{"index":1}`, `{"trackId":"V1"}`, `{"assetId":"..."}`, `{"itemId":"..."}`, `{"slotId":"..."}`, `{"speakerId":"..."}`, `{"id":"..."}`, or `{"sourceId":"..."}`. Prefer the stable `sourceId` from `source_list` / `read_captions`; their listed legacy aliases remain valid. Removing the last source reverts to the legacy single-track source.
- `source_update` — update one or more logical caption sources without moving caption tracks/items. Use it for per-source style, preset, visibility, or language changes; use the narrower `source_layout` for one source's position/size and `positions` for an atomic multi-source move. For a one-source preset, use `source_update` with its exact `sourceId` and `preset`. Non-layout updates can select by `index`, stable `sourceId` / `id`, `trackId`, `assetId`, `itemId`, `speakerId`, `label`, or nested `variant`. Any layout field requires the exact `sourceId` from `source_list` and receives an independent source-specific slot. Applying `preset` replaces that source's previous preset look while preserving its font size and line limits. Do not use whole-program `template` for a one-source request. To switch a source to English, either pass `variant:{"variantKind":"translation","languageCode":"en"}` or the shorthand `variantKind:"translation", languageCode:"en"` on that source update.
- `layout_policy` — how MULTIPLE caption sources share the screen (bilingual stacks, simultaneous speakers). It is NOT the tool for line limits or single-stream layout: for a line cap use `style` `maxLines` (number or `"auto"`), for one Source's global position use `layout`, and for one Card's position or width use `set_card_layout`. `{"mode":"single-lane"}` makes sources share the SAME caption position (best for VO and camera/audio tracks that alternate over time; if two sources overlap, priority/maxVisibleSources decides which is shown). `{"mode":"auto-stack","maxVisibleSources":2}` keeps sources in separate stacked bands (best for bilingual/simultaneous speech). `{"mode":"manual-slots","slots":[{"id":"top","anchor":"top-center","offsetYRatio":0.08},{"id":"bottom","anchor":"bottom-center","offsetYRatio":-0.08}]}` pins sources to explicit positions. Slot geometry uses ratios: `widthRatio`, `heightRatio`, `offsetXRatio`, `offsetYRatio`. Per-source overrides go in `perSource` keyed by `sourceId` (from `source_list`): `{"perSource":{"<sourceId>":{"maxLines":2}}}` lets one stream wrap to more lines than the shared item `maxLines` (e.g. original 1 line, translation 2) — by default both stacked lines share the item `maxLines`. Pass `{"layoutPolicy":null}` to clear.
- `positions` — move exactly the listed sources in one call; every entry requires the exact stable `sourceId` from `source_list`. Unlisted sources do not move. To move both original and English, provide both sourceIds explicitly: `{"positions":[{"sourceId":"<original-source-id>","anchor":"bottom-center","offsetYRatio":-0.08},{"sourceId":"<english-source-id>","anchor":"bottom-center","offsetYRatio":-0.02}]}`. Each listed source receives an independent slot, even when anchors match. Index, track, item, asset, speaker, label, and variant selectors are rejected because they can target or reorder the wrong lane. Use auto-stack/bilingual presentation instead when sources should intentionally share one stacked block. Per-source slot placement uses ratios; pixel `left` / `top` uses Source-targeted `layout`, while `width` / `height` remain shared measurement dimensions.

Source anchors and offsets in `source_update` and `positions` are canvas-relative. For example, `top-center` with `offsetYRatio:0.08` places the source 8% down from the canvas top even when the Caption Program box is elsewhere.

To show a translation: use `translate`. Do not create another captions item or video track just to separate caption languages/styles.

# Style fields

For the `style` action, pass any combination via `json`:

- **text** — `font`, `sizePx` (preferred human unit) or `fontSizeRatio` (stored internally as `sizePx / min(canvasWidth, canvasHeight)`, 0–1), `color`, `opacity` (0–1), `weight`, `variant`, `align`
- **stroke** — `strokeColor`, `strokeWidth`, `strokeOpacity`, `strokeOff`
- **current-word highlight** — `highlightColor` = active-word TEXT color. `highlightBackground` = a pill behind the active word, an object `{color, paddingX, paddingY, borderRadius, animation}` where `animation` is `"none"` (default) / `"fade"` / `"slide"` / `"bounce"`; it MERGES by key, so pass only what changes (e.g. `{"animation":"bounce"}` keeps the existing color). `highlightUnit` = `"word"` (karaoke that follows speech) / `"line"` (whole line lit at once) / `"off"` (none). For a plain "highlight the current word in <color>" request set `highlightColor` only; add `highlightBackground` only when the user wants a pill. Setting either `highlightColor` or `highlightBackground` auto-turns the highlight on (incl. CJK, off by default) — you needn't also pass `highlightUnit`. Turn highlight off with `highlightUnit:"off"`. (Unset default: CJK = off; every other language = `"word"`.)
- **background** — band behind the whole line: `backgroundColor`, `backgroundOpacity` (0–1), `backgroundRadius`; `backgroundOff:true` clears
- **shadow** — `shadowStrength` (0–100) or raw CSS `shadow` (e.g. `"0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.85)"`); `shadowOff:true` clears
- **typography** — `lineHeight`, `letterSpacing`, `textTransform` (`"none"` / `"uppercase"`, the panel's Aa/AA case control), and `direction`.
- **segmentation** — `segmentationPreset` = `"auto"` / `"phrase"` / `"word"` / `"custom"` changes the underlying Caption Card/Cue boundaries through the same Program constraints as the Content panel. These names share the pacing authority: Auto clears `wordsPerPage` and resets both wrap limits, Phrase sets three substantive tokens plus one line × 15 characters, and Word sets one substantive token plus one line × 5 characters. The token cap wins when applicable, so Word is exact rather than the old approximate five-character behavior. Custom requires `maxLines` and/or `maxCharactersPerLine` in the same call. Explicit limits (1-10 or `"auto"`; integer or `"auto"`/null) override a named preset when both are passed. Changes repaginate Cards once without resizing or repositioning the caption box. A Card-specific width makes both wrap dimensions Auto for that Card: width determines its local Max Characters and its existing content determines the required visual Max Lines. Appearance changes such as preset, font, size, spacing, stroke, and shadow never change layoutLines or Card boundaries. `set_max_characters` remains a convenience for changing only the Program character cap. Use `source_update` for source-specific visual limits, `layout` or `set_card_layout` for geometry, and explicit Card editing actions for authored boundaries.
- **pacing (structural Card granularity)** — `pacing` is the named Segmentation preset contract: `"auto"` restores natural segmentation and resets both wrap limits; `"phrase"` creates three-substantive-token Cards with one line × 15 characters for non-CJK; `"word"` creates one-substantive-token Cards with one line × 5 characters, including CJK. Punctuation stays attached to the preceding substantive token. Prefer the named value. Standalone compatibility calls `wordsPerPage:null`, `3`, and `1` canonicalize to the same Auto, Phrase, and Word contracts so the Viewer and Inspector cannot disagree; pass explicit `maxLines` or `maxCharactersPerLine` with a direct `wordsPerPage` only for a deliberate custom combination. Explicit low-level limits override named pacing when both are present. CJK counts greater than one fall back to character/punctuation segmentation. A pacing change rematerializes Cards atomically, invalidates previous Card ids, and requires a follow-up `read_captions` translation-coverage check.
- **display** — `displayMode` (`"single"` = one card / `"stacked"` = paper-card stack of recent lines), `hidePunctuation` (`true` removes a trailing full-width or half-width comma/period/semicolon/colon/ellipsis/顿号 at each semantic Caption line, and replaces the same weak punctuation inside Chinese lines with one space. Quotes, `!?！？`, English-line internal punctuation, and numeric separators such as `1.5` / `1,000` remain visible. `false` shows the source punctuation. This is render-only and leaves timing/transcript untouched). IMPORTANT: for ordinary requests to hide, reduce, simplify, or clean up punctuation, DEFAULT TO `true`. A request to remove every punctuation mark is a Card content edit, not a display-style change. `textTransform` (`"none"` for Aa / `"uppercase"` for AA)

# Examples

For an animated highlight, keep its background out of the normal span `style` and put `backgroundColor`, active `color`, and `animation` together in the sibling `activeStyle`; otherwise the normal background remains permanently visible under the animation.

For a true left-to-right highlighter wipe, use enter keyframes `{"offset":0,"clipPath":"inset(0 100% 0 0)"}` and `{"offset":1,"clipPath":"inset(0)"}` in that `activeStyle.animation`.

- Enable with the Plain default and all audible timeline sources: `{"action":"enable"}`
- Explicitly refresh a stale long caption Program: `{"action":"refresh"}`
- Destructively rebuild unreconcilable legacy captions after explicit user approval: `{"action":"reset","json":"{\"confirm\":true}"}`
- Narrow captions to a specific voiceover track after enabling: `{"action":"set_sources","json":"{\"sources\":[{\"trackId\":\"A1\"}]}"}`
- List built-in caption presets with style and pagination profiles: `{"action":"template"}`
- Apply a built-in caption preset: `{"action":"template","templatePreset":"deyi-card"}`
- Custom style: `{"action":"style","json":"{\"sizePx\":72,\"color\":\"#FFF\",\"shadowStrength\":45}"}`
- Keep every automatic Caption Card to one visual line without changing its box geometry: `{"action":"style","json":"{\"maxLines\":1}"}`
- Set both Program wrap limits in one resegmentation: `{"action":"style","json":"{\"maxLines\":2,\"maxCharactersPerLine\":15}"}`
- Apply the same short-phrase segmentation preset as the Content panel: `{"action":"style","json":"{\"segmentationPreset\":\"phrase\"}"}`
- Rematerialize as one substantive token per Card: `{"action":"style","json":"{\"pacing\":\"word\"}"}`, then run `read_captions` and use the new Card ids.
- Clean Chinese Caption punctuation by hiding weak line endings and spacing weak punctuation inside the line while preserving quotes, questions, and exclamations: `{"action":"style","json":"{\"hidePunctuation\":true}"}`
- Edit one Card: `{"action":"set_card_text","json":"{\"cardId\":\"<cardId>\",\"text\":\"Hello\",\"revision\":\"...\"}"}`
- Replace and retime Card tokens: `{"action":"set_card_tokens","json":"{\"cardId\":\"<cardId>\",\"revision\":\"...\",\"tokens\":[{\"tokenId\":\"<token-id>\",\"text\":\"Hello\"},{\"tokenId\":\"<token-id>\",\"fromFrame\":120,\"endFrame\":132}]}"}`
- Color one source in one Card only: `{"action":"set_card_style","json":"{\"cardId\":\"<cardId>\",\"sourceId\":\"<sourceId>\",\"style\":{\"color\":\"#8B4513\"},\"revision\":\"...\"}"}`
- Restyle exact words inside one Card: `{"action":"set_card_span_style","json":"{\"cardId\":\"<cardId>\",\"spans\":[{\"text\":\"South America\",\"style\":{\"color\":\"#FACC15\",\"fontFamily\":\"Bangers\",\"fontWeight\":\"700\"}}],\"revision\":\"...\"}"}`
- Animate an exact active word: `{"action":"set_card_span_style","json":"{\"cardId\":\"<cardId>\",\"spans\":[{\"text\":\"South America\",\"style\":{\"color\":\"#FACC15\"},\"activeStyle\":{\"animation\":{\"enter\":{\"durationMs\":180,\"easing\":\"ease-out\",\"keyframes\":[{\"offset\":0,\"opacity\":0,\"transform\":{\"translateY\":\"0.3em\",\"scale\":0.9}},{\"offset\":1,\"opacity\":1,\"transform\":{\"translateY\":\"0px\",\"scale\":1}}]}}}}],\"revision\":\"...\"}"}`
- Reset one Card's appearance: `{"action":"set_card_style","json":"{\"cardId\":\"<cardId>\",\"style\":null,\"revision\":\"...\"}"}`
- Move or resize one Card only: `{"action":"set_card_layout","json":"{\"cardId\":\"<cardId>\",\"layout\":{\"left\":220,\"top\":760,\"width\":700},\"revision\":\"...\"}"}`
- Restore one Card's inherited Source/global geometry: `{"action":"set_card_layout","json":"{\"cardId\":\"<cardId>\",\"layout\":null,\"revision\":\"...\"}"}`
- Widen and rewrap one Card without changing other Cards: `{"action":"set_card_layout","json":"{\"cardId\":\"<cardId>\",\"layout\":{\"width\":900},\"revision\":\"...\"}"}`
- Set every Card to Auto Max Characters: `{"action":"set_max_characters","json":"{\"scope\":\"all\",\"value\":\"auto\",\"revision\":\"...\"}"}`
- Split one Card before a word: `{"action":"split_card","json":"{\"cardId\":\"<cardId>\",\"beforeWordKey\":\"<token-id>\",\"revision\":\"...\"}"}`
- Split one Card into three at two boundaries in one call: `{"action":"split_card","json":"{\"cardId\":\"<cardId>\",\"beforeWordKeys\":[\"<token-a>\",\"<token-b>\"],\"revision\":\"...\"}"}`
- Merge adjacent Cards: `{"action":"merge_cards","json":"{\"cardIds\":[\"<cardId>\",\"<cardId>\"],\"revision\":\"...\"}"}`
- Rematerialize as one substantive token per Card: `{"action":"style","json":"{\"pacing\":\"word\"}"}`, then read the new Card ids.
- Caption all audible timeline sources: `{"action":"set_sources","json":"{\"mode\":\"timeline\"}"}`
- Put alternating VO/video-source captions in the same on-screen position: `{"action":"layout_policy","json":"{\"mode\":\"single-lane\"}"}`
- Translate English speech to bilingual Chinese above English: `{"action":"translate","json":"{\"languageCode\":\"zh\",\"mode\":\"bilingual\",\"primary\":\"translation\"}"}`
- Translate Chinese speech to bilingual Chinese above English: `{"action":"translate","json":"{\"languageCode\":\"en\",\"mode\":\"bilingual\"}"}`
- Show only the English translation, creating or refreshing it first: `{"action":"translate","json":"{\"languageCode\":\"en\",\"mode\":\"translation\"}"}`
- Restore the legacy original source: `{"action":"set_sources","json":"{\"sourceScope\":null}"}`
- Common bilingual original + English after the English translation exists: `{"action":"bilingual","json":"{\"languageCode\":\"en\"}"}`
- Custom bilingual/source arrangement: `{"action":"set_sources","json":"{\"sources\":[{\"trackId\":\"V1\"},{\"trackId\":\"V1\",\"variantKind\":\"translation\",\"languageCode\":\"en\"}]}"}`
- Move only the English source to the top: `{"action":"source_layout","json":"{\"sourceId\":\"<english-source-id>\",\"anchor\":\"top-center\",\"offsetYRatio\":0.08}"}`
- Remove the second source: `{"action":"source_remove","json":"{\"index\":1}"}`
- Rename a saved preset: `{"action":"preset_rename","json":"{\"name\":\"Podcast punch\",\"newName\":\"Podcast clean\"}"}`
- Title-safe layout: `{"action":"layout","json":"{\"sourceId\":\"<sourceId>\",\"preset\":\"bottom-center\"}"}`

action.description: One of: enable, disable, refresh, reset, set_card_text, set_card_tokens, set_card_style, set_card_span_style, set_card_layout, set_max_characters, split_card, merge_cards, reset_card, resegment_cards, cue_override, cue_reset, template, translate, style, layout, layout_policy, positions, preset_apply, preset_delete, preset_list, preset_rename, preset_save, bilingual, source_add, source_list, source_remove, set_sources, source_set, source_layout, source_update, track

captionsItemId.description: Captions item id (or short prefix) returned by read_captions. When provided, scopes style / layout / template / preset / source-track writes directly to that captions layer, bypassing default track-scoped lookup. For destructive reset, it chooses the visual/source settings to retain while every active captions item on the timeline is discarded. Use this when you've just located the captions layer via read_captions.

json.description: JSON for split_card after read_captions {"words":true}: {"cardId":"<cardId>","beforeWordKey":"<token-id>","revision":"..."}; for three or more Cards pass every boundary at once: {"cardId":"<cardId>","beforeWordKeys":["<token-a>","<token-b>"],"revision":"..."}. JSON for merge_cards: {"cardIds":["<cardId>","<cardId>"],"revision":"..."}. JSON for legacy resegment_cards: {"mode":"natural","revision":"..."} — prefer style {"pacing":"auto"} for new calls. JSON for reset_card uses editId, not cardId: {"cardId":"<editId>","revision":"..."}. JSON for set_card_style: {"cardId":"<cardId>","style":{"color":"#8B4513"},"revision":"..."}; use style:null to reset only that Card's appearance. JSON for set_card_span_style: {"cardId":"<cardId>","spans":[{"text":"South America","style":{"color":"#FACC15","fontWeight":"700"}}],"revision":"..."}; add languageCode/occurrence to disambiguate, or use style:null to clear that exact span. JSON for set_card_layout: {"cardId":"<cardId>","layout":{"left":220,"top":760,"width":700},"revision":"..."}; width-only preserves the current horizontal center, explicit left wins, and layout:null restores inherited Source/global geometry. JSON for track-wide style: {"font":"Inter","sizePx":72,"color":"#FFF","opacity":0.85,"strokeWidth":3,"strokeOpacity":0.9,"backgroundColor":"#000000","backgroundOpacity":0.5,"backgroundRadius":8,"shadowStrength":45} or {"fontSizeRatio":0.04,"highlightColor":"#facc15"}. Use one style pacing call for global automatic Card granularity; use split_card/merge_cards only for authored boundaries. sizePx is converted to stored fontSizeRatio = sizePx / min(canvasWidth, canvasHeight) in results. Source layout examples: {"sourceId":"<sourceId>","preset":"bottom-center"}, {"sourceId":"<sourceId>","bottom":200}, or {"sourceId":"<sourceId>","left":160,"top":820,"width":1600,"height":120}. Translation examples: translate {"languageCode":"zh","mode":"bilingual","primary":"translation"} for English original + Chinese-on-top, translate {"languageCode":"en","mode":"bilingual","primary":"original"} for Chinese original + Chinese-on-top, translate {"languageCode":"en","mode":"translation"}, or set_sources {"sourceScope":null}. In translate/bilingual, languageCode is the translation TARGET language, never the original language. Multi-source examples: source_set {"mode":"timeline"} or {"sources":[{"trackId":"V1"},{"trackId":"V1","variant":{"variantKind":"translation","languageCode":"en"}}]}; bilingual {"languageCode":"en"} ONLY (no sources array); source_remove {"index":1} or {"trackId":"V1"}; positions {"positions":[{"sourceId":"<original-source-id>","anchor":"bottom-center","offsetYRatio":-0.08},{"sourceId":"<english-source-id>","anchor":"top-center","offsetYRatio":0.08}]}; source_update {"updates":[{"sourceId":"<sourceId>","style":{"sizePx":72,"highlightBackground":{"color":"#facc15","paddingX":18,"paddingY":8,"borderRadius":10}}}]}; layout_policy {"mode":"single-lane"} or {"mode":"auto-stack","maxVisibleSources":2}. saved preset examples: {"name":"Podcast punch"}, {"name":"Podcast punch","newName":"Podcast clean"}.  JSON for set_max_characters: {"scope":"all","value":12,"revision":"..."} or {"scope":"all","value":"auto","revision":"..."}. For one Card use set_card_layout width instead.  JSON for one source in one Card: set_card_style {"cardId":"<cardId>","sourceId":"<sourceId>","style":{"sizePx":40},"revision":"..."} or set_card_layout {"cardId":"<cardId>","sourceId":"<sourceId>","layout":{"top":760},"revision":"..."}. Omit sourceId only to change every visible source in that Card.  JSON for source_layout after source_list: {"sourceId":"<sourceId>","anchor":"top-center","offsetXRatio":0.02,"offsetYRatio":0.08,"widthRatio":0.8}. This changes only that source lane. For positions, every entry requires an exact sourceId and only listed sources move.  JSON for a source-language-specific template catalog: {"languageCode":"en"}. Omit languageCode only when recommendations should consider every visible caption source.  JSON for reset: {"confirm":true} only after explicit user approval; it discards existing caption text, translations, Card edits, and word overrides while retaining visual/layout/original-source settings.

list.description: For action="track", list available source tracks instead of changing the captions source association.

preset.description: For action="enable": optional built-in caption preset id/name. Omit or pass "auto" for the default Plain visual style. For action="template": legacy alias for templatePreset; prefer templatePreset so it is not confused with enable presets, layout json preset, or USER-saved preset_* actions.

projectId.description: Existing project ID from the editor URL or list_projects. Pass this when continuing work on an existing project and the external MCP session is not already targeted.

templatePreset.description: For action="template" only: built-in caption preset id/name. Omit to list the language-aware recommendation catalog with styleProfile (actual visual behavior, excluding font size/position) and paginationProfile (preset-owned wordsPerPage pacing only); pass a returned id/name to apply it while preserving size, position, Max Lines, and Max Characters. An explicitly named valid built-in may also be applied directly even when it is outside the recommendation catalog.

trackId.description: Track alias (V1, A1) or ID for action="track" only. Do not pass this to action="enable"; to choose what captions visibly read from, use action="set_sources" with json like {"sources":[{"trackId":"A1"}]}.

trackOrder.description: Internal 0-based track order for action="track" only. Do not pass this to action="enable"; prefer user-facing trackId aliases like "V1", "V2", or "A1" after action="track" with list=true returns the exact order.
